public_rationale: Anthropic's deployment account documents an interruption caused by the decision that extended beyond publication of the forecast. The controls were lifted on June 30, with global Fable access scheduled to resume July 1. That satisfies the ordinary reading of a temporary deployment slowdown. Restoration and the continued availability of other models limit the finding; they do not erase the interruption.
limitations: Supported for a temporary deployment interruption, not an enduring slowdown in research or company-wide growth.
The decisive operational account is Anthropic's own disclosure.
The result depends on treating deployment interruption as slowing down the lab.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The White House decision will slow down Anthropic, one of the leading US AI labs.

statement.excerpt: And it will slow down one of the leading US AI labs.

from_speaker: one of the leading US AI labs
our_interpretation: The surrounding text identifies the lab as Anthropic and the cause as the June White House decision.
The plain reading includes an actual interruption or delay in Anthropic's research, releases or deployments caused by that decision.
No minimum duration or permanent loss of competitiveness is stated.
Because the shutdown began before the post, early resolution requires evidence that a qualifying interruption continued after June 14.
criteria.support_condition: A dated record documents a post-publication delay or interruption of Anthropic's research, releases or deployments attributable to the decision.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently complete operational record establishes that the decision caused no post-publication interruption or delay. Continued releases or growth alone would not disprove a temporary slowdown.

evidence.locator: Opening deployment update, paragraph beginning As of today
evidence.explanation: The surrounding account attributes the suspension to the June 12 directive and schedules global Fable restoration for July 1. This documents a deployment interruption extending beyond the June 14 forecast; the June 30 lifting is the dated endpoint used for resolution.

evidence.excerpt: Access to all other Anthropic models will not be affected.
evidence.explanation: The original notice limits the announced access interruption to Fable 5 and Mythos 5. It cautions against treating the episode as a shutdown of all Anthropic activity.

conclusive_event.meets_rule: The dated lifting and restoration account establishes that the decision's deployment interruption persisted after the forecast, meeting the rule for a temporary slowdown.
